user.title: Connect Ufanet intercom
user.description: Enter the account credentials to perform read-only discovery. No entrance is opened during setup.

acknowledge.title: Acknowledge discovered entrances
acknowledge.description: Read-only discovery found {discovered_count} entrances, {distinct_name_count} distinct names, and {duplicate_name_count} duplicate names. Before creating the entry, understand that calling button.press causes real physical actuation and opens an entrance; exposing this opening button to a remote UI, automations, or a voice assistant can also actuate it. Provider-supplied display names may be address-like and can persist in the entity registry, device registry, backups, Recorder/history, remote UI, and voice-assistant metadata. Duplicate names require careful identification. Confirm to trust all discovered bindings.

data.acknowledge: I acknowledge and trust all discovered entrance bindings

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Ufanet intercom
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current Ufanet password. No entrance is opened during reauthentication.

error.invalid_targets: The discovered entrances could not be validated.

abort.already_configured: This Ufanet account is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this Ufanet account is already in progress.
abort.unknown: The setup candidate is no longer available.

init.title: Ufanet Intercom options
init.description: Set up speech recognition, edit code phrases for each intercom, or refresh the intercom list. Resetting recognition settings is a separate action.

bindings.title: Refresh intercom list
bindings.description: Check the Ufanet intercom list. If new or changed intercoms are found, the form shows their counts and asks you to confirm trust. This check never opens an entrance.

adopt.title: Confirm new and changed intercoms
adopt.description: Intercoms needing confirmation: {pending_count}; new: {new_count}; changed: {changed_count}. Confirm to trust these intercoms. No entrance will be opened.

data.acknowledge: I trust all listed new and changed intercoms

voice_service.title: Speech recognition settings
voice_service.description: Enter the full speech recognition address and API key. Next retrieves the model list without sending audio or enabling recognition. A blank key keeps the saved key; enter it again when changing servers. Turning recognition off preserves settings and code phrases.

data.allow_insecure_http: Allow unencrypted HTTP on the local network

voice_device.title: Code phrases by intercom
voice_device.description: Choose an intercom to view or edit its code phrases. Each list applies only to that intercom’s current camera audio. Editing phrases does not switch recognition on.

voice_phrases.title: Code phrases
voice_phrases.description:
{target_name} · Stored phrases: {phrase_count}.

Up to 16 phrases, one per line. Edit lines and save. An empty field keeps the list; check the box below to delete it entirely. Deleting the final list stops recognition but keeps STT settings.

Phrase text is stored in Home Assistant configuration for administrator viewing, not in logs. Audio and transcripts are not saved.

data.clear_phrases: Delete all code phrases for this intercom

voice_reset.title: Reset recognition settings
voice_reset.description: Disables recognition and deletes the STT endpoint, token, model and all code phrases for this entry. Cameras and other Ufanet settings are unchanged. To pause without deleting, switch recognition off in Speech recognition settings.

data.acknowledge: I confirm deletion of STT settings and all code phrases

voice_phrases_legacy.title: Code phrases
voice_phrases_legacy.description:
{target_name} · Stored phrases: {phrase_count}.

The old list is preserved, but its text cannot be displayed. Re-enter it once to enable viewing: up to 16 phrases, one per line. An empty field keeps the old list. Check the box below to delete it entirely. Deleting the final list stops recognition but keeps STT settings.

Re-entered text is stored in Home Assistant configuration for administrators, not in logs. Audio and transcripts are not saved.

data.clear_phrases: Delete all code phrases for this intercom

voice_model.title: Recognition model
voice_model.description: Choose a model from the list or enter its exact name manually. A choice is required; no default model is selected for you. If the service offers models for different tasks, choose a speech recognition model. Refreshing the list does not change your saved choice.

error.invalid_targets: The intercom list could not be checked.
error.voice_service_required: First set an endpoint in Speech recognition settings. Recognition can remain off.
error.stale_target: The selected intercom or camera binding changed. Select it again.
error.too_many_targets: No more than eight intercoms can be configured.
error.invalid_phrases: Enter between one and sixteen valid phrases, one per line.
error.token_origin_changed: The STT server changed. Enter an API key again: the saved key is not sent to another origin.
error.invalid_model: Choose a model or enter its exact name without spaces. Empty values and default are not accepted.
error.models_unsupported: The catalog route is unknown for this endpoint path; no request was made. Enter an exact model ID manually.
error.models_unavailable: A valid catalog could not be retrieved (access, network or response error). Settings are unchanged. Enter an exact model ID manually or reopen service settings.
error.models_empty: The catalog contains no suitable IDs. Enter an exact model ID manually; settings are still unchanged.

abort.no_pending_targets: Intercom list checked. No new or changed intercoms need confirmation.
abort.adoption_successful: The new and changed intercoms have been confirmed.
abort.no_voice_targets: No current trusted intercom with a camera is available.
abort.unknown: Setup was interrupted. Open Options again.
